function.name: check_existing_patient
function.description: Checks whether a patient is already registered under the given phone number. Run this at the start of the call to detect duplicates or returning patients.

phone_number.description: The 10-digit US phone number of the caller (digits only, e.g. '4155552671').

function.name: create_patient
function.description: Persists a newly registered patient's demographic information after the caller has explicitly confirmed the full summary.

first_name.description: Patient legal first name (1-50 characters, letters, hyphens, apostrophes).

last_name.description: Patient legal last name (1-50 characters, letters, hyphens, apostrophes).

date_of_birth.description: Patient date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format (must be a valid past date).

sex.description: Patient biological sex for clinical demographic records.

address_line_2.description: Optional apartment, suite, unit, or building number (e.g., 'Apt 4B').

zip_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP code or ZIP+4 (e.g., '62704' or '62704-1234').

email.description: Optional patient email address (valid email format).

insurance_provider.description: Optional health insurance company name (e.g., 'Blue Cross Blue Shield').

emergency_contact_name.description: Optional full name of emergency contact.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional 10-digit US phone number of emergency contact.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Updates an existing patient's demographic information when a caller requests modifications to their existing record.

patient_id.description: The UUID of the existing patient record to update.
